info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Hotel Rooms Pricings-v4-spec
info.description: The Hotel Room Pricing API provides access to current pricing information for hotel rooms. It enables users to retrieve detailed pricing data, ensuring they are informed of the latest rates when booking accommodations. Typically used by travel agencies, booking platforms, and hotel management systems, this API streamlines the process of comparing and selecting hotel options. With an emphasis on real-time data retrieval, it supports efficient decision-making for consumers and businesses alike.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to access the current pricing information for various rooms available. You can use this to check rates, availability, and other pricing details essential for making reservations or inquiries.
